content.title: 'The Pitt' Season 2 Setting & Episode Count Revealed: Second Season Will Take Place Over Fourth of July - IMDb
content.text: 'The Pitt' Season 2 Setting & Episode Count Revealed: Second Season Will Take Place Over Fourth of JulyThe Pitt on HBO’s streaming service, Max, has quickly risen in the ranks to become one of the most popular shows on TV right now.Being praised for its accuracy, great performances, and interesting concept, the series was quickly renewed for a second season.If you don’t know, the show takes place over 15 hours during one shift at a Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania emergency room.Season 2 will follow this same format – with each episode being one hour of that ER shift.Keep reading to find out more…Executive producer R. Scott Gemmill confirmed at Deadline‘s Contenders TV event this weekend that season two will take place over Fourth of July weekend and is already in production.
